query: For my 93-year-old female admitted with ACS, among female ACS admissions aged 88–98 with initial Troponin T >0.01 ng/mL, report the median and IQR (ng/mL) of the first value.
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY value) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY value) AS interquartile_range FROM troponin_t_values;
